Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
DatabaseManager
public final class DatabaseManager extends Object
Utility class providing static methods for all database operations used by the POS application. Covers JDBC connections, employee authentication, product and inventory management, order submission, payment processing, and X/Z report generation.

    • submitOrderWithPayment

      public static DatabaseManager.SubmitOrderResult submitOrderWithPayment(List<DatabaseManager.OrderLineInput> orderLines, DatabaseManager.PaymentInput paymentInput) throws SQLException
      Submits an order to the database, records the payment, updates inventory, and logs hourly totals. The entire operation runs in a single transaction that is rolled back on any failure.
      Parameters:
      orderLines - the items being ordered
      paymentInput - payment details for the transaction
      Returns:
      a DatabaseManager.SubmitOrderResult containing the payment record ID and order ID range, or null if the order line list is empty
      Throws:
      SQLException - if inventory is insufficient or a database error occurs
